name: Nian NIA-FR02
summary: Nian NIA-FR02 is FiguRobot’s desktop humanoid companion robot. The manufacturer presents a miniature articulated humanlike body with voice, facial-expression and body-motion interaction, together with configurable character, voice and movement styles. Its product page shows both dressed and exposed-mechanism appearances. The cover preserves the official Mechanical Style portrait; it does not reconstruct lower-body parts outside the source image. Current delivery availability is unverified.
